Language learning resources

German

  • German in 3 months: textbook teaching German from scratch (I actually like the older editions of this book from Hugo better)
  • Dino lernt Deutsch: book series describing the misadventures of an international student in Germany, increasing in difficulty level
  • Tagesschau in einfacher Sprache: daily news explained in simplified German

Russian

  • The New Penguin Russian Course: curriculum building up Russian knowledge from zero, very succinct and well-structured
  • Russian with Max: comprehensible input from A2-B2 level about interesting topics, also on Spotify
  • Удивительное истории: 116 текстов для чтения, изучения и развлечения: Russian stories, often from famous authors, rewritten to use simple language and with uncommon vocab in the margins
  • Lernen Sie Russland kennen! (Valeria M. Nechaeva): book with authentic Russian readings and vocab definitions in the footnotes exploring Russia after the end of the USSR (but you have to know German)

Chinese

  • Hanzi Writer Demo: visualize correct stroke order of Chinese characters online
  • Chinese Grammar Wiki: explanations of Chinese grammar topics, sorted by A/B/C or by HSK levels
  • Lazy Chinese: comprehensible input in Mandarin, sorted by proficiency level and with interactive transcripts (both free and premium content)
  • 一千字說華語中英文版: open Mandarin textbook from Taiwan
  • Chinese in Levels: short daily news articles in Simplified Chinese, separated by difficulty level
  • A Frequency Dictionary of Mandarin Chinese from Routledge
  • The Journey to the West in Easy Chinese: the classical novel, rewritten to use a more limited vocabulary and set of characters
  • PunMemeCN: a GitHub repo of Chinese memes, together with structured data providing an explanation of each pun meme and example chat contexts in which it would be used
